the_gate: the field decode at 0x471B9E is reached ONLY when [ebp-0xC0] == last
[ebp-0xC0] is either the sentinel 0x1869F (when counter >= count) or a value read from the client's playerState history ring
the reset at entry (0x4719BE) applies to the STREAM struct (ecx+0x3BA0), while the comparison at 0x471AF0 uses ARG2's struct (eax+0x3BA0) - a different object that is NOT reset
so the loop can only decode once the client's ps history (arg2) already has entries
why_our_bodies_never_decoded_a_field: in a fresh session that history is empty, so counter >= count immediately, [ebp-0xC0] becomes the sentinel 0x1869F, and 0x1869F != last routes to 0x471C41 - skipping the field entirely
this matches every measurement: slot never fires, loop_c8 stays 0, slot_d0 (= last) is 0, and the snapshot still parses with stream_error 0
and it explains why an EMPTY playerState is accepted: the block legitimately decodes nothing when the history is empty
what_must_be_true_to_write_a_field: the client's ps history (arg2) must be seeded so that the ring lookup yields a value equal to `last`
that seeding most likely happens through normal gameplay traffic (multiple valid snapshots building history) or through the gamestate
so the server must drive the client through enough valid snapshots BEFORE a field can be written - a structural requirement ignored until now
